notes: DID IT DRAG BILLING INTO SCHEDULING? Yes — it is NOT self-contained. The faithful move kept the component's dependency on billing's `InvoiceStatus` type. Routed correctly through the public API (`import type { InvoiceStatus } from '@slices/billing'`), depcruise's no-circular rule fired with 3 errors: billing already imports scheduling (billing/ui/composables/useInvoiceList.ts -> @slices/scheduling for AppointmentSummary), so adding scheduling -> @slices/billing closed a billing<->scheduling cycle (verified: `x 3 dependency violations` on that version; vue-tsc still passed). The ONLY way to get all checks green was to sever the billing import and DUPLICATE the union locally inside the component (`type InvoiceStatus = 'draft'|'issued'|'paid'|'void'`). So the move still drags a billing domain type into scheduling — now as a silent copy rather than an import. Bottom line: this component cannot be relocated to scheduling and remain both faithful and self-contained; it either (a) imports billing and forms an illegal cycle, or (b) duplicates a billing domain type into an unrelated slice. Machine checks are green via (b), but the architecture signal is unambiguous: the badge belongs in billing (rule 5).
